subject: Restart daemon to activate t.assignee fix in active-claim
description: Restart the orchestrator daemon at ~/.claude/orchestrator to pick up the fix in orch/attempt/fix-active-claim-35 (routes/session.js: t.agent_id → t.assignee in /active-claim handler). Merge the branch first: cd ~/.claude/orchestrator && git merge orch/attempt/fix-active-claim-35 && npm run restart (or however the daemon is restarted). Verify: GET http://localhost:8787/active-claim?session=<some-session> returns non-empty claims for an in-progress subagent session.
